fixes.was: holding that an Arkansas court may hear a damages claim for injury to real property in another state when the defendant could otherwise escape any remedy.
fixes.now: holding that an Arkansas court may hear a damages claim for injury to real property in another state; its central concern was that the defendant could otherwise escape any remedy.
